summary.name: Monica
summary.one_liner: Monica is an all-in-one AI assistant that gives access to several leading AI models for chat, search, writing, coding, and research across web, browser extensions, and desktop and mobile apps.
keywords: gpt and claude in one app
use_cases: drafting or rewriting text on any web page
writing academic papers and literature reviews
generating code snippets and SQL queries
summary.what_it_does: Monica provides a sidebar that gives one-click access to its AI features from any web page. It lets users chat with several named leading AI models and offers a smart toolbar to explain, translate, or summarize selected text. A writing assistant helps draft or rewrite content in web pages. The page also lists professional features such as market intelligence reports, document analysis, academic citation and literature search tools, and code generation and optimization. The page does not give detailed pricing or technical specifications.
notable: Access to multiple leading AI models (named on page as GPT-6.1 Sol, Claude Opus 5.5, Gemini 4 Argon) in one place
Sidebar and selection toolbar that work on any web page
Built-in professional tools for research, citations, code, and customer support
caveats: Page does not state what is included in free use versus paid tiers, though the directory listing tags it #free
Page is mostly marketing; feature claims are not independently verified
Page claims 10 million users but gives no further detail
